text:
maria.chen: Starting canary for model v3-beta in us-west. Ramp 1% -> 10% over 30m. Need automatic fallback guards (variant fallback, regional failover, capacity). Proposing: error_rate >3% or p95>800ms triggers step-down. Opinions?

ajay: +1. Also add 'instance_free_gpus < 2' to trigger regional route to us-east.

ajay: Proposed rule snippet:

```yaml
fallbacks:
  - condition: "error_rate > 0.03 for 5m"
    action: rollback
  - condition: "p95_latency > 800ms for 5m"
    action:
      reduce_traffic: 50%
      fallback_variant: "v2-quant"
  - condition: "instance_free_gpus < 2 for 2m"
    action: route_region: "us-east-1"
  - condition: "queue_growth > 1000"
    action: enable_rate_limit: 0.5
```

lenora: We should use request_queue_growth and error-type filtering (4xx vs 5xx). For 4xx (client) don't rollback model. For 5xx (infrastructure) trigger regional failover.

kevin: Beware cascade: if we route to us-east, we might spin up more instances then hit cross-region quotas. Add circuit-breaker with cooldown and exponential backoff.

kevin: Suggest add fields:
`circuit_breaker: {max_fires: 2, cooldown: 15m, backoff: exp}`

olga: Console UX note — add a canary card that shows active fallback state + one-click 'force fallback' and 'suspend automation' toggle. Product/ops will need audit log for every auto-fallback.

maria.chen: Agree. Also we need telemetry: trace id mapping for fallback decisions, and link to the exact request sample that triggered the rule.

ajay: Will wire telemetry. plan: push config to staging today, dry-run mode logs decisions but doesn't act for 1h.

infra-bot: deploy started: canary/v3-beta -> us-west (1% traffic)

deploy-bot: dry-run: fallback-checker enabled (no actions until manual flip)

lenora: Quick ask — add metric for 'fallback_reason' tag so we can pivot dashboards.

maria.chen: @ajay please open an RFC with the final rules and add a short runbook for oncall. I'll schedule a 20m sync after staging verification. :thumbsup:

ajay: on it, will post RFC link here when ready.
